headline: The watchers learn to protect the planet
lede: Batch 19 of the WATCH rollout doesn't add seats — it makes the two newest brains actually good. Space Invaders' prover had a stall where it shot forts instead of aliens; Defender's patrol ignored the humans it was named after. Both are fixed, and both witnesses now measure the fix.

notes.text: Seed 1462 was INVADERS' shame: the watch route led its shots ~17px into the marching column, which often hung directly over a bunker — 511 ticks, one kill, then the fleet landed with lives untouched. The target law now prefers an invader whose meeting point flies over open sky; wave 1 clears on 20/20 witness seeds.

DEFENDER's patrol got the arcade's job ranking: haulers (landers carrying humans) outrank everything, dive-chasing landers next; it catches fallers (+250), rides the elevator down to deliver (+500), and holds its guns when a walking human stands in the laser line. Catches across the witness fleet went 8 → 46.

Every new law is pinned where deletion hurts: the SI stall-gap gate turns red when either half of the fix is removed, and 16/16 Defender mutants die — the honest numbers in both READMEs are now measured, not wished.
No new seats, tripwire steady at 58. The rollout's next batch already has its candidates written in the two READMEs' honest-gap lines.
